process_exit_contract: PASS requires TEST_PASSED, a normal make exit, and no TEST_FAILED marker. TEST_FAILED without TEST_PASSED remains FAIL even when make exits nonzero. Conflicting markers, an abnormal exit after TEST_PASSED and a cycle-limit marker are FAIL. Interrupted execution and a log without the Verilator command are INVALID.
comparison: Both the self-checking branch-misprediction counter program and the separate FPGA port checks must pass.
selected_configuration: target=default with build_axi4 and fpga_optimize enabled; the runner regenerates the selected headers before make

port_test.purpose: Check enabled capture of the complete prediction packet, hold, and asynchronous reset at both actual EXU widths.
